editorial:
Imagine you are a single mom just trying to do the right thing for your kid. You take a side gig as a ride share driver to save up for college tuition, thinking it is just an easy way to make extra cash. But things go south fast when you pick up a passenger who seems normal at first but is actually a dangerous predator. You will feel the tension grow as this stranger turns your life into a nightmare, following your every move and targeting your family. It is a scary look at how a simple app can let a monster right into your personal space.

The acting is solid and the pacing keeps you on the edge of your seat without feeling too slow. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the suspense makes up for it. If you love stories about stalkers and survival, you should definitely check this one out. It looks great if you can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but renting it on Apple TV is also a quick way to watch. If you love owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the killer traps the mother in a desperate fight for survival. After a tense game of cat and mouse, she manages to outsmart him using her knowledge of her own neighborhood. She fights back hard and eventually kills him to protect her daughter. The movie wraps up with her finally safe, though she is left scarred by the experience and will probably never want to drive a ride share car ever again.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival thrillers and stories about overcoming dangerous odds.
